# Literature search ledger

Search date: 21 July 2026.  Sources were checked on publisher pages, arXiv
records, DOI metadata, and the official Clay statement.  Reviews and reference
works were used for discovery; the bibliography favors primary articles.

| Query family | Representative query | Screened primary results | Decision |
|---|---|---|---|
| Structural realism | `group structural realism Roberts` | Worrall 1989; van Fraassen 2006; Roberts 2011 | Included; blocks an unqualified “relations are fundamental” inference |
| Gauge and surplus structure | `gauge surplus structure theoretical equivalence` | Belot 2003; Dewar 2019; Nguyen--Teh--Wells 2020 | Included; establishes locality costs of reduction |
| Theory equivalence | `physical equivalence AQFT representations` | Coffey 2014; Lupher 2018; Fewster 2015 | Included; motivates property-relative equivalence |
| Duality | `schema duality bosonization representation interpretation` | De Haro--Butterfield 2018 | Included; exact duality distinguished from approximation and recovery |
| RG/EFT epistemology | `renormalization group methods epistemology effective field theories` | Wilson--Kogut 1974; Butterfield 2011; Rivat 2021; Koberinski--Fraser 2023 | Included; “RG” is not treated as one generic information-loss map |
| Perspicuous/perspectival representation | `perspicuous representation physics` | North 2026; current perspectivism literature screened | North included as closest recent paper; books/reviews left for final venue pass |
| Categorical QFT and semantics | `functor local quantum field theory same physics` | BFV 2003; Fewster 2015; Goguen--Burstall 1992 | Included as neighboring formalisms, not antecedents of the same calculus |
| Relational information | `Relational Quantum Mechanics Rovelli` | Rovelli 1996 | Included to distinguish state-relativity from cross-representation proof certificates |
| Euclidean reconstruction | `Osterwalder Schrader Euclidean Green functions` | Osterwalder--Schrader 1973, 1975 | Included as the physical reconstruction interface |
| Yang--Mills target | `Clay Yang Mills official problem` | Jaffe--Witten official statement; current Clay page | Included; current status remains open |
| Terminology collision | exact phrase `representational dynamics` | cognitive science, neuroscience, and machine-learning uses dominate | Retain only with the qualifier “proof-bearing”; define explicitly |

No search located an identical framework combining heterogeneous
preservation/loss/recovery profiles, an indexed dense-core spectral transport
criterion, exact countermodels, and the complete Yang--Mills proof interface.
That is a bounded search conclusion, not an absolute priority claim.  A final
subscription-database and citation-index search is required before submission.
